entity.name: Nikhil P
entity.description: I'm a solo developer in Bengaluru, India, building iVibe full time. I designed, built and shipped it alone, with six public releases since October 29, 2026.

projects.name: iVibe
projects.description: iVibe is an open-source voice layer for your computer, for Windows, macOS and Linux. Press one shortcut, show your screen and talk. Fix turns a spoken bug report into a prompt with marked-up screenshots for your coding agent. Prompt turns rambling into a clear prompt. Dictate writes clean text in any app. On-device OCR and secret redaction run before anything leaves the computer. Next are Vibes, modes that users make themselves by choosing what a mode can see and where the result goes, and a note taker built the same way.
